window_kv.initialization: zero allocated storage; visibility limited by request positions
window_kv.update: write current token into position mod128 before read; prefill retains last128
window_kv.validity: only causal local window of current query, layer/request identity preserved
window_kv.reset: new request start_pos0 writes valid prefix/tail; positions beyond valid prefix masked

global_kv.initialization: zero cache; valid length0 per request
global_kv.update: emit complete group, indexer reads unrotated latent, rotate+QDQ then write, then read
global_kv.validity: C=floor(end_position/ratio), source layer and request fixed
global_kv.reset: new request start_pos0 rebuilds valid prefix; stale tail never visible
global_kv.alias: shared.compress_kv reassigns to source-owned storage at every Full layer

index_k.update: derive from compressor latent BEFORE RoPE mutation; rotate index keys at group first position; FP4group32 then cache
index_k.validity: completed groups only, matching KV owner and current request
index_k.reset: valid prefix overwritten on prefill; owners publish before consumers each forward
index_k.alias: shared.index_k aliases current Full owner; Reindex read only

selected_indices.initialization: empty until first index source; empty int32 selection when C=0
selected_indices.update: every index source replaces selection including query rows and window offset
selected_indices.validity: one forward only, exact query positions/compression ratio/KV producer/window offset
selected_indices.reset: replaced before each consumer every forward, never carry previous token selection

candidates.initialization: undefined until layer20; never read earlier
candidates.update: layer20 recomputes max-per8 block mask and pins newest valid block every forward
candidates.validity: same query rows and C; causal score mask still applied downstream
candidates.reset: overwritten layer20 every forward before all consumers

compressor_partial.update: position mod2 slot; prefill retain Tmod2 tail; emit only after both slots written
compressor_partial.validity: per-source layer/request and current incomplete group
compressor_partial.reset: new request valid partial overwritten; no emission until whole new group valid

engram_history.initialization: uninitialized allocation with no valid positions
engram_history.update: commit compressed ids or DEAD for current contiguous token slice
engram_history.validity: only positions0..end-1 of this request; stop lookback at DEAD/start
engram_history.reset: new request writes from0 and masks negative lookback; stale tail unread
engram_history.alias: one request history supplies both configured Engram layer hash families

dspark_window.initialization: zero allocated cache; prefill seeds target-hidden KV
dspark_window.update: only main target token commits into ring; speculative draft KV ephemeral
dspark_window.validity: target committed positions, at most128, distinct cache per auxiliary layer
dspark_window.reset: new prefill replaces valid target history; drafts never persist
